title: Senior Security Engineer - Detection and Response
Cyber Security Engineer
description_html: NVIDIA's Enterprise Security team is looking for a Senior Engineer responsible for maintaining and advancing our Identity Governance and Access Management platforms. This is a high-impact role at the center of NVIDIA's Zero Trust security journey — one that combines deep technical ownership with the opportunity to shape how a world-class technology company secures its identity infrastructure! Are you passionate about identity security and ready to make a measurable difference at scale? Here's what the role looks like.    What you'll be doing:   The Senior Engineer will build the strategy, planning, and management of our enterprise-wide Zero Trust architecture while driving continuous improvements across Active Directory, Entra ID, and SailPoint environments. Working alongside multi-functional teams, this position focuses on designing and implementing robust security policies and access controls, and providing technical mentorship on infrastructure improvements, third-party integrations, and platform upgrades across the organization.  This role holds accountability for the strategy, roadmap, and operations of our identity management and governance — ensuring tight alignment with our broader Zero Trust initiatives. A key part of the work involves spotting process gaps, implementing improvements, and establishing engineering guidelines that set the standard for the entire team. Specific responsibilities include:   Implementing identity security capabilities such as SSO, conditional access, MFA, and privileged access.  Administering and evolving the SailPoint IdentityNow environment, including governance workflows, access certifications, role management, and integrations with enterprise applications.  Managing vendor relationships to resolve issues and deliver new platform features.  Championing development standards and fostering a culture of continuous improvement.  Applying AI tooling to improve infrastructure visibility and stability: telemetry, health checks, anomaly detection, and AI-assisted diagnostics that surface issues before users report them and give end users faster, self-service resolution.     What we need to see:    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.  10+ years of solid experience in handling Active Directory and Entra ID environments.  Strong command of authentication protocols including LDAP, Kerberos, SAML, and OAuth.  Experience with MFA and SSO technologies.  Expertise across the full identity lifecycle: User Lifecycle Management, Access Certifications, Access Requests, role management, Workflow automation, and Delegated Administration.  Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation and operational tasks, plus practical experience using AI tools in day-to-day engineering work.  Hands-on experience with an Identity Governance platform — SailPoint IdentityNow or IdentityIQ strongly preferred.  Demonstrated experience resolving intricate identity and access challenges.

title: AI Security Engineer
description_html: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for  all .    Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.    AI agents are becoming part of how work gets done, and adversaries are learning to attack them and to attack with them. This role exists to protect those systems and to make sure we can detect, contain, and recover when they are targeted. As a Staff AI Security Engineer, you build the tools, solutions, architectures, and frameworks that secure our sanctioned AI estate and defend against agentic threats across their full lifecycle, from prevention through response and recovery. This is a hands-on, individual-contributor role on the Cyber Defense and Resiliency team, working with the Senior Manager, Technical Network Security. You spend most of your time building, and your work sets the technical direction that others follow.   You operate where emerging AI capability meets practical security engineering! On one side you build and operate the protective controls that keep our approved AI solutions safe to use. On the other you translate novel agentic attack patterns into working defenses, automated response actions, and reusable frameworks that the broader organization can adopt. You are comfortable moving fast in an area where the playbooks are still being written, and you bring rigor to a space that rewards it.        Responsibilities:    Build and harden security tools that protect AI agents, model-backed services, and supporting infrastructure by securing system configurations, access, and integrations.  Operate and mature AI guardrails, including in-line model protections, prompt-injection defenses, and data-loss prevention, in partnership with AI enablement and governance teams.  Design detection capabilities for agentic threats, including prompt injection, tool/function abuse, identity and credential misuse, data exfiltration, and agent memory or context manipulation.  Develop automated, machine-speed response and containment tools with tiered authority for reversible and irreversible actions.  Enable rapid, scalable revocation of compromised agent access and credentials, while restoring agent configurations, tool registries, and supporting services to a known-good state.  Create and document reusable architectures, reference designs, and frameworks that enable consistent security and defense of agentic systems across the organization.  Partner with detection and response, threat intelligence, platform engineering, and AI enablement teams to operationalize solutions and serve as a technical authority who strengthens organizational capabilities.  Evaluate emerging AI security tools, techniques, and research through focused experimentation, bringing the strongest solutions into production.       Minimum Qualifications:    8+ years of experience in security engineering, detection and response, or related fields, with a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) and strong software engineering expertise in Python, APIs, data pipelines, and security platforms.  Hands-on experience securing AI and enterprise environments, including AI agents and LLM applications, tool/function calling, retrieval and memory, orchestration frameworks, Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations, and the implementation of security controls such as AI guardrails, DLP, identity and access management, and application/endpoint protection.  Good foundation in security operations and architecture, including detection and response engineering, automation, telemetry analysis, blast-radius assessment, containment, credential and secrets management, network and endpoint security, incident response, technical documentation, and the ability to drive complex initiatives from concept to production with minimal direction.         Preferred Qualifications:    Deep expertise in securing and hardening AI/agentic systems, including adversarial ML techniques, AI red teaming, and the implementation of production-grade AI security controls and guardrails.  Strong knowledge of AI and cybersecurity frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, OWASP LLM Guidance, NIST Cybersecurity Framework) with experience aligning engineering practices to resilience, threat detection, incident response, and recovery objectives.  Proven enterprise-scale security experience across cloud and on-premises environments, complemented by contributions to the AI security community through open-source projects, research, thought leadership, and relevant security or cloud certifications.        As a world leader in the semiconductor industry, Micron is dedicated to your personal wellbeing and professional growth. Micron benefits are designed to help you stay well, provide peace of mind and help you prepare for the future.  We offer a choice of medical, dental and vision plans in all locations enabling team members to select the plans that best meet their family healthcare needs and budget.  Micron also provides benefit programs that help protect your income if you are unable to work due to illness or injury, and paid family leave.  Additionally, Micron benefits include a robust paid time-off program and paid holidays.   For additional information regarding the Benefit programs available, please see the Benefits Guide posted on         micron.com/careers/benefits       . title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Cloud Infrastructure
description_html: NVIDIA's deep learning platforms are at the forefront of innovation, profoundly impacting various fields and widely adopted by leading academic institutions, startups, and major Internet companies globally. We're seeking an accomplished and highly skilled Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our NVIDIA DGX Cloud team. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate, results-oriented, and creative individual to deliver exceptional value to our DGX Cloud customers.   We are specifically looking for a TPM with extensive experience in cloud infrastructure  bring-up with external partners. You'll be instrumental in partnering with CSPs, emerging cloud providers and engineering teams internally to help build AI capacity and infrastructure across the globe     What you'll be doing:   As a DGX Cloud Technical Program Manager, you'll be a key partner to our Engineering, Infrastructure, Software teams and their leadership, driving critical programs related to AI capacity enablement and management. You'll play a pivotal role in developing and maturing foundational capabilities and processes for DGX Cloud, spanning critical areas such as cluster/capacity bring-up including CPU, storage, networking and compute requirements to support GPUs.  This is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where TPMs are expected to apply fungible skillsets to a range of high-impact programs across DGX Cloud.   Collaborate with storage and network engineering teams to define and communicate workload requirements — including speeds, feeds, and infrastructure readiness — to CSPs and NCPs, driving alignment on a plan of record (POR) for capacity blocks.  Drive early engagement with CSPs and NCPs to understand their managed storage and network solutions and influence alignment with the NVIDIA Cloud roadmap.  Gather technical requirements, develop comprehensive roadmaps, establish clear milestones, and ensure adherence to the Product Lifecycle (PLC) process.  Manage ongoing capacity operations and engineering engagement with CSP and NCP partners, collaborating with engineering leads on availability, maintenance, and critical performance indicators.  Leverage Jira and other program management platforms to instill rigor and structure in the management of engineering deliverables.  Identify and drive opportunities to onboard third-party and in-house cloud infrastructure solutions across deployments, support, security, compliance, and observability for DGX Cloud.  Establish KPIs to quantitatively demonstrate program value and impact while proactively identifying, resolving, and mitigating risks affecting scope, schedule, and quality.  Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement, consistently identifying opportunities for process enhancements within cloud infrastructure operations..     What we need to see:    8+ years of technical program management experience, specifically driving the planning and execution of large-scale cloud infrastructure programs with external partners, with a strong focus on software engineering projects within a matrixed organization.  Extensive hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, preferably gained from working at a major Cloud Service Provider (CSP).  Domain knowledge in the bring-up and end to end operations of compute, storage and GPU (including common failure points at the HW and SW levels).  Expert-level proficiency with Jira, Smartsheet, or similar program management tools, with the ability to confidently guide engineering teams on their use of the tools.  Exceptional strategic and tactical thinking abilities, coupled with a strong capacity to build consensus and drive program success  Comfort and effectiveness in thriving within ambiguous environments.  Possess excellent communication and technical presentation skills, particularly for executive audiences.  BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.     Ways to stand out from the crowd:    In-depth knowledge of NVIDIA GPU products, including deployment and bring-up, combined with deep familiarity with cloud-native product and services environments.  Working knowledge of cloud technologies including Kubernetes, API integration, Terraform, and related tooling.  Familiarity with AI and ML infrastructure, with an understanding of how NVIDIA’s deep learning platforms are applied across academic, startup, and enterprise environments.  Significant experience with productivity tools and process automation, with a keen eye for identifying and driving process improvement opportunities.  A highly enthusiastic, energetic, responsive, and passionate individual who thrives in fast-paced environments and is driven to deliver meaningful value to DGX Cloud customers.    Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family  www.nvidiabenefits.com/      Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 168,000 USD - 258,750 USD for Level 4, and 200,000 USD - 322,000 USD for Level 5.           You will also be eligible for equity and  benefits .           Applications for this job will be accepted at least until October 25, 2026.   This posting is for an existing vacancy.   NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes.
